sentences.text: Shri Amit Lahoti, learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri D.S. Tomar, learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent-State.
Case Diary is perused.
Learned counsel for the rival parties are heard.
This is first bail application under section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

Applicant apprehends arrest in connection with Crime No.401/2018 registered at Police Station Joura, District Morena (M.P.) for the offences punishable under sections 392, 506 and 427, 34 of IPC and Section 11/13 of the MPDVPK Act.

Prosecution story in short is that complaint was lodged to the effect that on 29/07/2018 at about 9.30 pm present applicant Harendra and other co-accused persons namely Sachin, Bablu Tyagi,
Sachin S/o Rakesh and other 6-7 persons armed with iron rod and Danda came on the spot and assaulted the complainant as well as others.
On the aforesaid basis, crime has been registered.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that he has falsely been implicated in the matter and applicant is a businessman.
It is submitted that Section 392 of IPC is not attracted as there is no allegation of theft against the applicant and therefore Section 11/13 of the MPDPK Act is also no applicable.
It is also submitted that applicant is reputed citizen of the locality having no THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH ( Harendra Tyagi VS The State of Madhya Pradesh) criminal record.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH ( Harendra Tyagi VS The State of Madhya Pradesh)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Though, co-accused Sachin has already been released on bail by this Court under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C vide order dated 28/09/2018 passed in M.Cr.C. No. 34736/2018.
Present applicant is a licence holder under the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and runs a dairy business.
He is also Director of Nagar Panchayat, Joura, District Morena (M.P.).
There is no likelihood of his absconsion with the prosecution evidence and he is ready to abide the terms and conditions which may be imposed by this Court.
It is prayed that benefit of anticipatory bail be extended to the applicant.

In response, learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application and prays for its rejection and it is submitted that investigation is pending and interrogation may be required in the matter and pointed out that there are direct allegation of beating and looting Rs. 25,000/-.
The role attributed to the present applicant stands corroborated with the statement of one Arun Shrivastava and specific overtact has been assigned to him and investigation is pending.

sentences.text: However, it would not be desirable to enter into merits of the rival contentions at this juncture.
It is well settled that the considerations governing grant of anticipatory bail are altogether different from those relevant for the prayer for regular bail.

THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH ( Harendra Tyagi VS The State of Madhya Pradesh)
Taking into consideration the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, in the opinion of this Court, no case for grant of anticipatory bail is made out.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH ( Harendra Tyagi VS The State of Madhya Pradesh)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The application , therefore, stands rejected.

(S.A.Dharmadhikari) JUDGE Prachi PRACHI MISHRA 2018.11.02 15:46:25 +05'30'
